chars.FAYSAL: FAYSAL: a young man wearing a fitted charcoal grey suit, light blue shirt, dark red tie and a blue staff badge on a lanyard
chars.TEACHER: TEACHER: an old man wearing thick black-framed glasses, a beige trench coat over a brown cardigan, grey trousers
chars.SON: SON: a young man wearing a bright yellow hoodie, ripped light blue jeans and white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan consulate waiting hall with a red Moroccan flag and service counters. In the center, TEACHER and SON are being stopped by a big security guard in a black uniform who holds his arm out; SON shouts angrily, TEACHER looks ashamed. In the background, FAYSAL stands behind a glass office door holding a phone, watching seriously. Tense atmosphere.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: FAYSAL sits at his office desk in the consulate, phone pressed to his ear, frowning and listening carefully, a Moroccan flag on a small stand and stacks of passports and files on the desk, window with a grey European city outside.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At a consulate service counter, SON nervously slides a document across the counter; a female clerk in a navy blazer holds the paper up to the light with a magnifying glass, eyes narrowed with suspicion. SON sweats and looks away.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The female clerk in a navy blazer picks up a desk phone to call the police while SON panics with both hands on his head and TEACHER leans over the counter pleading with open hands. Consulate counter, people queuing in the background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the consulate hall SON angrily shoves a big security guard in a black uniform in the chest, the guard stumbles back, chairs knocked over, other visitors step back in shock.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: TEACHER sits alone on a plastic chair in an empty consulate waiting room, holding a thick folder of papers, his head down in one hand, exhausted and humiliated, a wall clock and a red Moroccan flag behind him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: FAYSAL stands up from his office desk, buttoning his suit jacket with a determined look, ready to go, the door of his office open to a long consulate corridor.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: FAYSAL opens the door of a consulate waiting room and stops in the doorway; across the room TEACHER, seen from behind sitting on a chair, slowly turns his head. Dramatic light from the doorway, mysterious and tense mood.
